seo.title: Agadir Corniche | Seafront Promenade & Beach Strip | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Walk the Agadir Corniche: seafront promenade linking beach hotels, cafés and the marina along the Atlantic bay.
seo.keywords: Agadir Corniche, Agadir promenade, seafront Agadir, beach strip

name: Agadir Corniche
hero_subtitle: The seafront promenade that links Agadir’s beach hotels, cafés and the walk toward the marina.

overview.title: Agadir’s seafront walk
overview.p1: The Corniche is the paved edge between the sand and the hotel line. It is where people walk, jog, sit for coffee and watch the Atlantic without stepping onto the beach itself.
overview.p2: At one end you drift toward the marina; at the other the beach continues south. It is flat, easy and central to any beach-based stay in Agadir.

food.title: Eat on the corniche
food.p1: Cafés and casual restaurants face the promenade — convenient for a stop without leaving the shore zone.
food.li3: Hotel restaurants a few steps inland.
food.li4: Marina options at the north end.

1.title: Access
1.desc: Open public promenade; no ticket. Petit taxis stop all along the strip.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Sunrise and sunset are the most pleasant for walking.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Link a corniche walk with beach time, the kasbah viewpoint or the marina.

q1.question: Is the corniche the same as the beach?
q1.answer: The corniche is the promenade behind the sand. You can walk it without going onto the beach.

q2.question: Is it safe at night?
q2.answer: The main strip is generally busy and lit in the evening; normal big-city awareness still applies.

q3.question: Good for running?
q3.answer: Yes — flat and continuous along much of the bay.

q4.question: How long is it?
q4.answer: Several kilometres if you walk the full hotel and beach frontage.

q5.question: Best section?
q5.answer: The stretch facing the main hotels toward the marina is the most animated.

1.title: Joggers and coffee
1.desc: Cooler air and a quieter seafront walk.

2.title: Sun on the strip
2.desc: Busy hotel edge — seek shade for longer stops.

3.title: Evening stroll
3.desc: The classic time for the corniche and marina link.
